tool_calls.saw: Dense urban and industrial fabric is visible: a main road running north-south through the centre, large warehouse-style structures with blue and red roofs, smaller residential blocks, and bare reddish-brown terrain at the edges consistent with the coal-bearing landscape of Shanxi Province. params.title: Sentinel-2 True Colour: Jincheng City Watch Site, 2026-04-04
params.description: Dense urban and industrial area, Shanxi Province, China

observations: TROPOMI recorded a 14-day median anomaly of +122.6 ppb above background at this site (2026-10-07 to 2026-10-21), the highest of all nine watch areas scanned.
EMIT looked 11 times (2024-02-17 to 2026-04-25); NASA outlined no plume here in the plume product.
4 raw EMIT passes were read since 2025-01-01: 2 rejected within noise (peak 3,501.9 and 2,049.3 ppm·m), 1 too weak (peak 735.6 ppm·m), 1 cloud or gap.
Sentinel-2 on 2026-04-04 shows dense urban and industrial fabric with large warehouse-scale structures and bare reddish terrain consistent with the coal-bearing landscape.

explanations.next_check: A confirmed EMIT plume on a new pass with no concurrent heat would support venting as a hypothesis.
A new EMIT pass with a confirmed plume and no prior heat would be consistent with an undetected leak.
VIIRS saw no heat over 30 nights; a mapped flare stack nearby would be needed to assess this hypothesis.
A new EMIT pass coinciding with coal mine ventilation schedules would help distinguish coal from pipeline sources.
A short-duration EMIT plume on a single date with no repeat would be consistent with a blowdown.

gaps: NASA's plume product is nearly empty after 2025-09-22; passes after that date have not been checked for outlined plumes.
EMIT only sees this site on its orbital passes; gaps between passes leave days to weeks unobserved.
The public registry lists no oil and gas facility within 2 km; a registry gap is not evidence of an empty site.
Carbon Mapper lists no plume within 7 km since 2025-01-01, but its publication lag is about 30 days.
params.next_collection: A new targeted EMIT pass or Tanager-1 overpass over this site would determine whether the TROPOMI anomaly corresponds to a point-source plume.
